tagline: Token-efficient requirements graph with PKM-style linking.
keyFeatures: Token-efficient .rq files: a name, short body, links to ideas/code/tests
PKM-style naming, wikilink-style idea linking, and tagging for requirement graphs
VS Code/Cursor extension with Langium-based language server
CLI and MCP server both use the same requirement graph index
Rust core for index and CLI performance
Static analysis for specifications: link validation, reference tracking, graph traversal
limitations: Very early stage project (~3 GitHub stars, first releases Aug 2026)
Solo maintainer with no proven track record or established user base
Requires learning a custom DSL (.rq syntax) separate from code
AGPL-3.0 license may be restrictive for commercial use
No orchestration layer — a requirements language, not a full SDD workflow
